result.topic_en: Gauss's notes on the lemniscatic (elastic curve) sine and cosine, giving their fundamental relation, doubling formulas and addition/subtraction formulas, with substitutions toward further formulas.
result.transcription:
{+Lemniscata+}
In der Curva [-elastica-] ist

s Sinus eines Bogens
c Sinus des Compl. des B.

$ss+cc+ccss=1$

Sinus des Dopp. | $\frac{2(s+s^3)c}{1+s^4} = \frac{2sc}{1-sscc} = \frac{2sc}{ss+cc}$
Cosinus des Dopp. | $\frac{1-2ss-s^4}{1+2ss-s^4} = \frac{cc-ss}{1+ccss} = [-\frac{1+2ss+ccss}{2+ss+cc}-]$
$= \frac{cc-ss}{2-ss-cc}$

Sinus der Summe $\frac{s'c+sc'}{1-s'sc'c}$ | d. Diff $\frac{s'c-sc'}{1+s'sc'c}$
Cosinus der Summe $=\frac{c'c-s's}{1+s'sc'c}$ | d. Diff. $\frac{c'c+s's}{1-s'sc's}$

$\cos(A-B).\sin(A-B) = \cos(A+B).\sin(A+B)$

man setze $\frac{s+c}{[-sc-]}=t$
$1-sc=u$ so ist immer
$tt+uu=1$ ferner v. doppelten B[?].

$T=\frac{2-2u}{tt+2u-2}+$ $-1-2u-uu$
[-...-]

$1-s^4=t^4$
$\frac{1-ss}{1+ss}=cc$
$\frac{tt}{1+ss}=cc$
Sinus d. S.[?] {+E+}{+[?]+}
$[-?-] = \frac{tT}{uU-u-U+2}$

S. d. D. $\frac{2st}{1+s^4}$

$sc+s'c'$
S. d. S. $\frac{s'\frac{tt}{1+ss}+s\frac{t't'}{1+s's'}}{1-s's\frac{tt t't'}{(1+ss)(1+s's')}}=$
$\frac{s'tt+s'^3tt+st't'+s^3t't'}{1+ss+s's'+sss's'-s'sttt't'}$
